notes.title: Kickstarter in progress - We need your help!
notes.notes:
We are currently running a Kickstarter for Vivid to help the title become a reality for all platforms including Steam. LucasMaxBros has been working on Vivid for almost five years and needs assistance with getting across the finishing line. With your help in spreading the word, we really hope to be able to reach the developers goal and be able to provide them with bringing the best possible game upon release. 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1300585294/vivid-a-kirbyvania-inspired-adventure/

With the extra funds raised we will be able to bring an outstanding audio track to the game, grab development kits so we can port to as many platforms as we can and use the bonus cash to inject more time into the title as well as being able to fully polish it off. We want Vivid to be the best it can be.
 
By pledging today we have various rewards such as posters, the ability to design in game balloons and enemies as well as being able to have early access to the beta levels and of course our eternal gratitude.

Thank you so much for your time, we hope that you will be able to enjoy Vivid's and Spirits adventure together.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35699973/6303265e10ea77f26cda880520820b364a270001.png[/img]

~Kitty Skies
